name: session-lifecycle
body: Session lifecycle and exclusivity: `apg session start` launches the coordinator and binds the worktree socket; `apg session end` releases the worktree DB and socket and exits — there is no accumulated projection flush to perform, because each mutation's exact delta was applied write-through as it completed; a stale socket left by a crash is reclaimed by the next command/session; one session per worktree DB; a live session and `apg scan` / `apg project merge` are mutually exclusive. Realized by `apg.session.Coordinator.start`, `.end`, and `.reclaim_stale_socket`.
